albedo_1: This is typical of a dark traditional roof, which reflects 5 to 15% of solar radiation (US EPA).
albedo_2: Comparable to a grey roof, which reflects about 20% of solar radiation (Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory).
albedo_3: Range of light-coloured roofs and coloured “cool” shades: a roof that reflects 35% of sunlight stays about 12 °C cooler than a dark roof of the same appearance (LBNL).
albedo_4: Level of cool roof materials, which reflect more than 65% of solar radiation (US EPA).
albedo_5: Level of a clean white roof, which reflects about 80% of solar radiation and stays about 31 °C cooler than a grey roof (LBNL).

noclim_line: Without air conditioning, there is no summer bill to reduce, but less overheating: in high summer, a dark traditional roof gets 31 to 47 °C hotter than the air, a reflective roof only 6 to 11 °C (US EPA).

cee_abroad: CEEs are a French scheme: other incentives may exist in Switzerland, Italy and Spain.
cee_sector: This sheet covers tertiary buildings in commercial use. During the study, we check whether another scheme applies to your site.
cee_refl: Sheet BAT-EN-112 requires a roof without any reflective coating before the works.
cee_noclim: The roof must cover an enclosed, air-conditioned volume.
cee_heat: The sheet requires heating and cooling to be provided by a heat pump.
cee_ok: Subject to eligibility, based on €8.70 per MWh cumac (standard CEE price index, June 2026). The amount paid depends on the funder.
cee_half: Calculated on half of the roof, above the air-conditioned part.
cee_use: The commercial use of the building, required by the sheet, needs to be checked.
cee_zone: Zone H2 used until you enter your postcode.

pt_levels: , over {n} storeys: the gain applies to the top storey.
pt_light: Roof already grey or light-coloured: the gain used is half that of a dark roof.
pt_damaged: Damaged roof: the waterproofing must be renewed before any coating.
pt_repairs: Some repairs needed before application, priced during the visit.
pt_good: Roof in good condition: application after cleaning and surface preparation.
pt_asbestos: Fibre cement: an asbestos survey is essential before work (in France, it is mandatory for buildings constructed before 1 July 1997).
pt_noheat: Unheated building: no extra heating cost in winter.
pt_winter: In winter, the roof captures slightly less solar heat: this small extra heating cost is generally offset by the summer savings (US EPA).
roi_refl: Your roof is already reflective: a new coating would bring little in savings.
roi_noclim: Without air conditioning, there is no summer bill to reduce: the return is judged on staff comfort, the protection of goods and the roof.
